# Etra Dreams

> > Premium VFX studio delivering visual effects services including rotoscopy, compositing, match-move, paint prep, and CGI integration for major entertainment clients.

Etra Dreams is a visual effects production company with operations in Sattur (Tamil Nadu, India) and Montreal (Canada), serving major studios including Paramount, Warner Bros, and Amazon. The company specializes in comprehensive VFX services for film, animation, and advertising projects.

- VFX Services
- Visual Effects
- Rotoscopy
- Compositing
